title: Identify the top 3 cities in California with the lowest total K-12 enrollme
question: Identify the top 3 cities in California with the lowest total K-12 enrollment that also contain at least one active school with an SAT reading score above 500. For each such city, return the city name, the number of qualifying schools, and the highest SAT math score among those schools.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_schools AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_041 AS cds, s.XCL_050 AS city, sat.XCL_037 AS math_score
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
    WHERE s.XCL_044 = 'Active'
      AND sat.XCL_038 > 500
),
city_enrollment AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_050 AS city, SUM(f.XCL_019) AS total_enrollment
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    GROUP BY s.XCL_050
),
city_stats AS (
    SELECT
        qs.city,
        COUNT(DISTINCT qs.cds) AS qualifying_schools,
        MAX(qs.math_score) AS highest_math_score
    FROM qualifying_schools qs
    GROUP BY qs.city
)
SELECT
    cs.city,
    cs.qualifying_schools,
    cs.highest_math_score
FROM city_stats cs
JOIN city_enrollment ce ON cs.city = ce.city
ORDER BY ce.total_enrollment ASC
LIMIT 3

WITH qualifying_schools AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_041 AS cds, s.XCL_050 AS city, sat.XCL_037 AS math_score
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
    WHERE s.XCL_044 = 'Active'
      AND sat.XCL_038 > 500
),
city_enrollment AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_050 AS city, SUM(f.XCL_019) AS total_enrollment
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    GROUP BY s.XCL_050
),
city_stats AS (
    SELECT
        qs.city,
        COUNT(DISTINCT qs.cds) AS qualifying_schools,
        MAX(qs.math_score) AS highest_math_score
    FROM qualifying_schools qs
    GROUP BY qs.city
)
SELECT
    cs.city,
    cs.qualifying_schools,
    cs.highest_math_score
FROM city_stats cs
JOIN city_enrollment ce ON cs.city = ce.city
ORDER BY ce.total_enrollment ASC
LIMIT 3
